title: SARA ASSICURAZIONI
subtitle: Web3 Backbone
description:
Reimagining insurance engagement through digital ownership.
A customer engagement platform designed to support new policy subscriptions and upsell strategies through personalized NFT rewards.
Each NFT represents the selected insurance plan and its validity, creating a secure and traceable digital asset with limited issuance. The system strengthens customer engagement while introducing a new layer of digital interaction between users and the brand.
